en: Browse Chadhava sevas: https://lifeguru.app/mandir-chadhava — message us if you need help choosing.
hi: Chadhava options: https://lifeguru.app/mandir-chadhava — madad chahiye ho to likhein.

en: Namaste 🙏 A chadhava is an offering made at the temple in your name and gotra. You pick the offering on https://lifeguru.app/mandir-chadhava, fill name and gotra, and pay. The recorded video is sent on WhatsApp within 3–4 days. You can book more than one offering in the same order. 🙏
hi: Namaste 🙏 Chadhava mandir mein aapke naam aur gotra se hota hai. https://lifeguru.app/mandir-chadhava par offering chunein, naam aur gotra bharein, payment karein. Video 3–4 din mein WhatsApp par aata hai. Ek order mein ek se zyada offering ho sakti hai. 🙏
